articles.title: A 16-Year-Old Guitar Hero From Thailand Just Won America's Got Talent!
articles.summary: Nene Royal, a 16-year-old from Thailand, shredded her electric guitar on America's Got Talent and won the whole season. Her first audition got 21 million views online!

articles.title: Why Did Carlos Alcaraz Smile After Losing at 3:34 in the Morning?
articles.summary: Tennis star Carlos Alcaraz lost a five-hour match at 3:34 a.m. — then walked off smiling. He said he missed the feeling of competing after a wrist injury kept him out for months.

articles.title: SNL Is Back! A Basketball Star Is Hosting the Big Season 52 Premiere
articles.summary: Saturday Night Live returns tonight with host Jalen Brunson, a New York Knicks point guard fresh off an NBA championship. KATSEYE is the musical guest.
